closed_loop_influence_audit.evidence: CEMPlanner, UncertaintyPenalizedCEM, and PredictiveCBFSafetyFilter operate strictly on continuous state/variance predictions and sensor measurements; predict_mode_set/aps_quantile are passive offline diagnostics only, so no 570-episode replay is required.

ood_auroc_audit.label_and_score_convention_verified: Correct original convention: positive label y=1 denotes OOD (offline_test_ood), y=0 denotes ID (offline_test_id); higher uncertainty score predicts OOD. No sign reversal applied.

task2_1step_vs_h1_reconciliation.reconciliation_summary: Both metrics use identical physical 23-D targets and identical single-step forward predictions (max_abs_diff <= 4e-6). one_step.state_rmse pools all transitions t=0..T_i-1 (n=1192 ID, 1493 OOD), whereas multihorizon_rmse['1'] evaluates ONLY initial transitions t=0 (n=40 per pool). M4 achieves lower error on sustained contact transitions t>=1, while exhibiting higher normal-force transient error at t=0 pre-contact onset (fn_12_16 = 1.61-2.50 N vs M0 0.64-0.87 N).

root_causes: PlannerEvaluator.reward_fn sign inversion at z < 0: -float(... - min(0.0, peg_z)*5.0 ...) penalizes insertion below z=0 at -5.0/mm, making z=0.0 mm (15 mm depth) the planner optimum; C13 reaches contact at steps 24-35 and stalls at z ~ -2.2 mm.

In C14-C18 (125/125 episodes), max_peg_force_mean == 0.0 N: the peg never reaches z <= 0.0 within 50 steps due to slow CEM descent (raw_cand_dz ~ -0.09..-0.26 mm/step) and lateral drift (2.6-13.7 mm), with C15 M0|B3 uncertainty penalty driving peg upward (z: 14.3 -> 27.5 mm, 0.00 mm depth).
PredictiveCBFSafetyFilter force plunge dampening fired 0 times (exec_dz_mean == raw_cand_dz_mean in all traces); interventions only damped rotational tilt.

b4_joint_coverage_audit.audit_summary: Denominator n=40/pool and all frozen Phase 3.4 Bonferroni joint quantiles are verified exact without recalibration. The low 2.5%-17.5% (Task 2) and 45.0% (Task 1) values in phase35_offline_120ep_results.json evaluated L2 norms across all steps 1..T_avail (up to 50) with 1-p(y) mode score against quantiles calibrated under EpisodeConformalEngine (L_inf over HORIZONS={1,3,5,10,20} with compute_aps_score). Under the exact matched EpisodeConformalEngine event, ID reaches 38/40 (95.0%) while OOD drops to 35/40 (87.5%) M0 and 32/40 (80.0%) M4.

safety_vs_success_analysis.finding: All 150 Compliant Pre-Lift ID and 150 OOD episodes are analytically grasp-feasible (4*mu*18 N >= W). In C11 (M4|B2|OOD), 5 of 6 task successes still exceeded the 25 N crush safety limit (only 1/25 clean success in Regime A), alongside 8 failed crush episodes (13/25 total violations). Conversely, M0|B2/B3 produced 0 safety violations alongside 0 successes.
